guarantees.claim: When state is StIdle, op_busy_o is deasserted (0).
When state is StAdv, adv_en_o is asserted (1).
When state is StAdv and kmac_done_i is high and cnt_i equals CDIs-1, op_ack_o is asserted, state_d set to StIdle, op_update_o remains low.
When state is StAdv and kmac_done_i is high and cnt_i is less than CDIs-1, op_update_o is asserted and state_d set to StAdvAck.
When state is StAdvAck, state_d is set to StAdv and adv_en_o is deasserted (default low).
When state is StWait, gen_en is asserted (1).
When state is StWait and kmac_done_i is high, op_ack_o is asserted and state_d set to StIdle.

When state_q does not match any defined state (StIdle, StAdv, StAdvAck, StWait), op_ack_o is asserted, op_fsm_err_o is asserted, and state_d remains unchanged (state_d = state_q), creating a stuck error state.
In all states except StIdle, op_busy_o is asserted (1) because only StIdle overrides the default assignment.
In all states except StAdv, adv_en_o is deasserted (0) because only StAdv overrides the default.
In all states except StWait, gen_en is deasserted (0) because only StWait overrides the default.

assumptions.claim: cnt_i is incremented monotonically and never exceeds CDIs-1 during StAdv state, and kmac_done_i is pulsed only when cnt_i is within [0, CDIs-1].
assumptions.risk: If cnt_i exceeds CDIs-1 or kmac_done_i occurs with out-of-range cnt_i, the FSM may never reach the op_ack_o branch, causing permanent stall.

assumptions.claim: kmac_done_i is a pulse that deasserts before the next request is processed after returning to StIdle.
assumptions.cond: After returning to StIdle from StAdv or StWait
assumptions.risk: If kmac_done_i stays high, a subsequent request immediately sees kmac_done_i high and may prematurely complete, skipping required operation cycles.

assumptions.claim: The request inputs adv_req_i, dis_req_i, id_req_i, gen_req_i are mutually exclusive; at most one category is asserted at a time.
assumptions.risk: If both adv/dis and id/gen are asserted simultaneously, the FSM prioritizes adv/dis and transitions to StAdv instead of StWait, potentially leading to incorrect operation sequence.

uncertain_points.claim: The default error state asserts op_fsm_err_o and op_ack_o but leaves state_d unchanged, effectively locking the FSM. It is unclear whether a separate recovery mechanism (e.g., external reset or escalation) is intended or if this can lead to deadlock.
uncertain_points.risk: If the error state is entered, the system may hang indefinitely with no safe recovery path, potentially blocking key management operations.

uncertain_points.claim: The parameter CDIs is used in comparisons (CDIs-1). If CDIs is set to 0, the condition cnt_i == CDIs-1 becomes cnt_i == -1 (wrapped) and cnt_i < CDIs-1 becomes cnt_i < -1, which may never be true, causing StAdv to stall permanently.
uncertain_points.risk: A legal but extreme parameter value leads to deadlock in the advancement state machine.

uncertain_points.claim: cnt_i is an input whose generation logic is outside this chunk. The guarantee that cnt_i never exceeds CDIs-1 relies on an external counter. Verification must ensure that counter is properly bounded and reset across operations.
uncertain_points.risk: If the external counter overflows or is not properly reset, the FSM may stall or misbehave as per A1.

uncertain_points.claim: After StAdvAck, state_d = StAdv re-asserts adv_en_o in the next cycle for only one cycle low. It is unclear whether kmac interface requires adv_en_o low for a minimum duration or until kmac_done_i deasserts.
uncertain_points.risk: If kmac misses the low pulse due to timing or requires longer deassertion, the handshake may break, leading to incorrect operation.

uncertain_points.claim: op_update_o is asserted for exactly one cycle during StAdv (when transition to StAdvAck), then deasserted. It is unclear if a single-cycle pulse is sufficient for the update operation downstream.
uncertain_points.cond: state_q == StAdv and kmac_done_i && cnt_i < CDIs-1
uncertain_points.risk: If the update action requires more cycles, data may be lost or incomplete.

uncertain_points.claim: When cnt_i equals CDIs-1, the FSM asserts op_ack_o directly without asserting op_update_o. It is ambiguous whether the final CDI also requires an update before acknowledgment.
uncertain_points.risk: If an update is needed for the last CDI, skipping it may leave state incomplete.
